services.name: Kids’ “Tie a Fly with Dad/Mom” Night
services.desc: A lighthearted, hands-on evening designed to bring families together through the art of fly tying. The goal isn’t to create professional-grade flies — it’s to create memories. Parents and kids work side-by-side, laughing, learning, and leaving with something they made together. --- What’s Included Guided instruction by one of our professional fly tiers. All materials and tools provided. --- What They'll Learn Simple fly-tying concepts: hooks, thread, materials, and tools Step-by-step instruction Basic handling of tools (vise, bobbin, scissors) with parental supervision How flies Family night, reimagined — fun, educational, and unforgettable.

services.name: Intro to Fly Tying Class
services.desc: 🪶 Intro to Fly Tying – 2-Night Evening Class Overview Discover the art of fly tying in this fun, hands-on introductory class designed for anglers of all levels.
